q: In the Borel hierarchy, a Gδ set (G_δ = Π⁰₂) is a:
opts: Finite union of open and closed sets
exp: Gδ sets are countable intersections of open sets (G for German 'Gebiet'=open, δ for 'Durchschnitt'=intersection). Examples: the irrationals in ℝ (intersection of complements of rationals), the set of continuity points of a monotone function.
